title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning Whether the People's Courts Shall Accept Lawsuits Filed Due to Disputes over Telegram Delays by Post and Telecommunications Departments

articles.content_en: 1. For a dispute arising from delay of telegram by the postal and telecommunications department, if a party files a prosecution with a People's Court, the People's Court shall accept the case as long as the conditions set forth in Article 108 of the Civil Procedure Law are met.

2. Where any relevant judicial interpretation issued by the Supreme People's Court prior to this Reply is inconsistent with this Reply, this Reply shall prevail.
This reply is hereby given.
